services.name: Training Enhancement Programs
services.desc: Factory Theatre’s Training Enhancement Programs is a workshop intensive for early career artists to collaborate, connect and create new work. Over the course of three weeks, our cohort of selected artists become members of a small theatre company where they participate in masterclasses, workshops, and readings, to stage a short performance work that is showcased at the end of the program. This year the program will take place between June 3rd- 27th. The training program is coordinated by Kalale Dalton-Lutale and has an acting, playwrighting and directing stream.
